idea: Themed weeks, School and health day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In the 2023-24 family health survey, 20.7% of people in Kerala's surveyed households were aged 60 or over and 20.3% were under 15: level. In India as a whole, 12.9% were 60 or over and 25.5% under 15, about two children for every older person.

Kerala's share aged 60 and over was the highest of 34 ranked states and Union territories (Goa next, 17.2%). In the earlier survey, 2019-21, Kerala had 18.6% aged 60 and over against 20.6% under 15. Survey estimates, not a census count.
source: International Institute for Population Sciences, National Family Health Survey: NFHS-6 (2023-24) India and state fact sheets (total, urban and rural columns), which also print the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure. Indicators: people aged 60 and over, and people under 15, each as a share of the people in the surveyed households. 34 states and UTs with data; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no figure in the sheets used. Survey estimates, not a census count.
